name: Nanaki Kazuaki
source:
Hiyoko, Ryouta, Sakuya and San's narcoleptic [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coturnix_chinensis]King Quail[/URL] homeroom (2nd Year, Class 3) teacher, who also teaches mathematics. In spite of his slow and steady pace, Kazuaki is an incredibly intelligent bird whom possesses a brilliant mind.

[Based on the [URL=http://clione.halfmoon.jp/hatoful-boyfriend/character/nanaki.html]official website[/URL].]
